Opinion of the Judge : Accused No.1 & 2 are  found not guilty.
JUDGEMENT

This is a charge sheet filed by the PSI of Parappana Agrahara police police station against the accused No.1 & 2 for the offence punishable U/Sec.498A R/W 34 IPC.
02.
It is the case of the prosecution that, the accused No.1 is the husband of CW.1 Smt.S.Kavitha got married on 25.10.2007 as per Hindu customs.

After the marriage, CW.1, the accused persons along with their two children were resided within the limits of Parappana Agrahara Police Station,
Bengaluru and C.C.No. 1862/2021 thereafter the accused persons with common intention picked up quarrel with CW.1 in respect of silly reasons and they caused mental and physical cruelty and thus the accused persons have committed the above said alleged offence.
03. After filing of charge sheet, this court took cognizance for the offence punishable U/Sec.498A R/W 34 IPC and issued summons to the accused persons.
Accordingly the accused persons appeared before the court through their counsel and enlarged on bail.

Later on, charge sheet copies and prosecution papers were furnished to the accused persons under Sec.207 of Cr.P.C.
04.
Heard both side on framing of charge, perused the prosecution papers.

As there are sufficient materials to frame the charge against the accused persons, the charge has been framed and the same was read over to them, but they denied the contents of the same and claimed for trial.
Hence the case was posted for prosecution evidence.
In furtherance of the charges leveled against the accused, the following points are arisen for my consideration.
POINTS 01.
Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubt that, the accused No.1 is the husband of CW.1 Smt.S.Kavitha got married on 25.10.2007 as per Hindu customs.

After the marriage, CW.1, the accused persons along with their two children were resided within the limits of Parappana Agrahara Police Station, Bengaluru and thereafter the accused No.1 started to ill treat CW.1 with the instigation of accused No.2 with common intention picked up quarrel with CW.1 in respect of silly reasons and they caused mental and physical cruelty and thus the accused persons have committed the offence punishable U/Sec.498A R/W 34 IPC.?

06. In order to prove the case, the prosecution has examined CW.4, 7, 5 & 1 as PW.1 to 4 and got marked the documents as per Ex.P1 to Ex.P6.
CW.2, 3, & 6 are dropped.

After completion of evidence of prosecution, the incriminating circumstances in the evidence of the prosecution is read over to the accused No.1 & 2 and statement under section 313 of C.C.No. 1862/2021 Cr.P.C.
recorded.
The accused No.1 & 2 have denied the incriminating circumstances as false and not chosen to lead their side defence evidence.

07. Heard the arguments and perused the decision produced by the counsel for accused No.1 & 2 along with memo passed by Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in SLP (Criminal No.16239/2024)
decided in the matter of Daralakshmi Narayana and Others Vs. State of Telangana and another.

My findings on the above said points are as follows:-
Point No.1 : In the negative.

Point No.2: As per final order, for the following:
REASONS 08. POINT No.1 :- The prosecution has been launched on the basis of complaint lodged by the CW1 for the offence punishable U/Sec.498A R/W 34 IPC. and investigation was taken place on the allegation made by the complainant/CW1 as per the contents of the complaint/Ex.P1.

Further it is relevant C.C.No. 1862/2021 to note here that, in criminal cases the measure of scale tilts or the amount of evidence require to prove the guilt of the accused persons are based on the principle of beyond all reasonable doubt.
The prosecution has to prove the chain of events without any missing link, which contributes to the commission of the offences.

In the back drop of the above principle,
now let me analysis the evidence of the prosecution witnesses.
09. The prosecution has examined CW.4, 5 &1 as PW.1, 3 & 4 respectively.
PW.1 & 3 being the parents of PW.4 have categorically deposed that, the marriage of the PW.4 and accused No.1 solemnized on 25.10.2007 in 'Achuth Kalyana Mantapa' situated at Nellore, Andrapradesh.
They spent more than 30 lakhs rupees during marriage ceremony.

Further, PW.1 and PW.3 deposed that,
PW.4 and accused No.1 came to Bengaluru and started to reside in KR Puram.
Thereafter, they shifted to Parappana Agrahara.

In February 2019, they went to C.C.No. 1862/2021 house of PW.4, at that time, PW.4 nothing has shared about her family life and all of a sudden stated that, "... 
 
 
      
  
,
The accused No.1 wrongfully confined PW.4 in the house and went away leaving her alone.
The accused No.1 & 2 tortured her mentally and physically by demanding additional dowry.
Further, PW.3 deposed that, after giving birth to female child, CW.1 suffering from thyroid problem.
Accused No.1 forced CW.1 for male child, due to thyroid problem CW.1 got aborted.
Again, she become pregnant forcefully.
Thereby, they supported the case of prosecution.

sentences.text: Further, PW.4 in her examination in chief has deposed that, on 28.01.2010 she given birth to a female child.
She was healthy till 2012, thereafter the accused No.1 forced her for second baby.
When she refused for the same, he started to blackmail her C.C.No. 1862/2021 emotionally.
In February 2013, accused No.1 went to Singapur, after two months, she also joined him.
He shown her site seens in Singapur.
But, they not leading happy married life.
After 2 months, she returned from Singapur along with child and staying with her parents at Nellore.
In the month of October, the accused No.1 came to her parental house and stayed with them for a weak.
Thereafter, he came to Bengaluru for his work.
She also joined him in KR Puram house.
The accused No.1 used to stay in his friend's room without taking care of her and he used to come at 8.30 am., and go to attend his office work.
The said routine continued for 3 to 4 months, he complained about her to her relatives about refusing for second child.
She was suffering from hyper thyroid, for that, the doctor strictly instructed her and accused No.1 not to go for second child till a year.
But, even after that, he forced for second child.
Thereafter, on 25.03.2018 she given birth to male child.

The accused C.C.No.
1862/2021 No.1 has not intimated her parents about the birth of child, even he has not sent her to her parents house after the delivery.
Whenever, her parents come to see her, at that time, the accused refuse to come to the house.
After 10 days of delivery, the accused No.1 insisted her to do the all the house hold works.
He arranged to puja ceremony in Nellore even though the environmental condition was bad and he threatened her to take the child for said ceremony in her absence.
He forced her to took the child to his relatives house when she refused for that, he used to quarrel with her.
He fixed the Mudi ceremony when the child become 11 months old without intimating her.
When she went to her parental house with anger.
The accused No.1 came to Bengaluru from Nellore and changed the lock of the house, when she came to the said house in the mid night 12 to 12.30 am., she found the lock to the house door.
She called several times to him, but he not received her call.
For that, she stayed in a hotel and C.C.No. 1862/2021 next day, she called duplicate key maker and instructed him to prepare a key, thereafter she opened the door and sent her daughter to school.
Thereafter, she stayed along with her daughter in the said house for 6 months.
But, the accused No.1 not visited the house and not taken care of them.
For that, her daughter admitted in the hospital.
Wherein, she went in Coma condition, for that, she informed the accused No.1 about the ill health of their daughter.
He visited the hospital and went away.

After a weak, she discharged her daughter from the hospital, came to residence, but accused No.1 not returned house and used to visit the daughter in the school once in 2 - 3 months in the school itself.
Therefore, she waited for 6 months and lodged complaint against him.
Accused No.2 called his father and abused him in filthy language.
The accused No.1 tortured her only with the instigation of accused No.2.
Thereby, she too supported the case of prosecution.

The prosecution has examined CW.7 as PW.2, who being the Investigation Officer has deposed about receiving of written complaint submitted by CW.1, registering of crime, submitting FIR before the court and his Higher Authority.
Further deposed about conducting of panchanama on 26.11.2019, obtaining the statements of CW.4 to 6 and obtaining of further statement of CW.1 and deposed about submitting of charge sheet.
Thereby, he supported the case of prosecution and deposed about discharging of his official duty.

Apart from that, most of the questions asked to her in her cross examination,

Which also clearly reveals that, the PW.4 residing with her parents neglecting the accused No.1 and his parents.
Further PW.1 in her cross examination dated 06.07.2024 has deposed that, the accused No.1 started to ill treat her since 2012.

But, she has given a complaint on 20.10.2019 which is registered as NCR and given another complaint on 25.11.2019, but in between 2012 to 2019, she was not given any complaint before the jurisdictional Police Station.
Therefore, there is a delay of 7 years to register a complaint and the reasons for delay not at all mentioned.
Which, itself creates doubt about the incidents narrated by the complainant in Ex.P.1.

For this, I have gone through the decision of Hon'ble Supreme Court of India, reported in 1973 AIR 501 decided in the matter of Thulia Kali vs The State Of Tamil Nadu wherein it is held that;
C.C.No. 1862/2021 " The first information report in a criminal case is an extremely vital and valuable piece of evidence for the purpose of corroborating the oral evidence adduced at the trial.

entities.text: Thulia Kali vs The State Of Tamil Nadu
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The object of insisting upon prompt lodging of the report to the police in respect of commission of an offence is to obtain early information regarding the circumstances in which the crime was committed, the names of the actual culprits and the part played by them as well as, the names of eye witnesses present at the scene of occurrence.
Delay in lodging the first information report quite often results in embellishment which is a Creature of after thought.
It is therefore essential that the delay in lodging the report should be satisfactorily explained."
Such being so, herein the instant case also, there is a 7 years delay to register the complaint and wherein no reason is mentioned.
Hence, which creates doubt about the case of prosecution.

Apart from that, the complainant has suppressed so many material facts with respect of financial matters/
transactions took place between accused No.1 and her parents with respect to purchase of site and hide the matter of depositing of amount by the accused No.1 in her SBI Bank Branch, C.C.No.
1862/2021 Nellore and dispute arose between her brother and her brother's wife etc.,

For that, I have gone through the cross examination dated 27.03.2024 wherein she deposed as "...1

Which also clearly reveals that,
PW.4 denying the so many facts deliberately.

For this, the counsel for accused No.1 & 2 relied upon the decision passed by Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in SLP (Criminal No.16239/2024) decided in the matter of Daralakshmi C.C.No. 1862/2021 Narayana and Others Vs. State of Telangana and another, wherein para No.18 it is held that;
"

entities.text: Daralakshmi C.C.No. 1862/2021 Narayana and Others Vs. State of Telangana and another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: A bare perusal of the FIR shows that, the allegations made by respondent No.2 are vague and omnibus.

Other than claiming that, appellant No.1 harassed her and that appellant No.2 to 6 instigated him to do so, respondent No.2 has not provided any specific details or described any particular instance of harassment.
She has also not mentioned the time, date and place or manner in which the alleged harassment occurred.
Therefore, the FIR lacks concrete and precise allegations."
Here in the instant case also, the CW.1/ PW.4 barely stated that, the accused No.1 started to harass her since 2012.
But, no date mentioned on which date and how he harassed.
Hence, the decision relied by the counsel for accused persons is aptly applicable to the present case on hand.

Apart from that, the panch witnesses and the eye witness not took trouble to enter into the witness box, more particularly CW.6 being the own brother of PW.4 has not turned to depose the version of complaint given by her sister against his brother in law i.e., accused No.1.
Hence, for the reasons and decisions discussed supra, the doubt arises in the mind of the Court regarding the C.C.No. 1862/2021 mental and physical torture by the accused No.1 & 2 to the CW.1 / PW.4.
Hence, it creates doubt about the case of prosecution.
The prosecution failed to bring home the guilt of the accused persons.

Thus,
there are no any incriminating materials to establish the alleged offence leveled against the accused persons.
Therefore, the prosecution has utterly failed to prove the alleged offence against the accused No.1 & 2 beyond all reasonable doubt.
Hence, I answered the Point No.1 in the negative.
15. POINT NO.2:

In view of reasons stated above on points No.1, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER

By exercising powers conferred U/sec.
248(1) of Cr.P.C., the accused No.1 & 2 are acquitted for the offence punishable U/Sec. 498A R/W 34 of IPC.

The bail bond and surety bond of the accused No.1 & 2 shall continue in force for a C.C.No. 1862/2021 period of 6 months for the purposes of section 437(A) of Cr.P.C.
The accused No.1 & 2 are set at liberty.
